# OneNest

> A retail incubator for independent brands inside the UK's biggest shopping centres.

OneNest is a launchpad for small independent brands to test selling in real shopping malls without the risk. It is built for online-first sellers, market and craft-fair traders, and local makers who want a permanent spot without taking a unit. A cohort of up to four curated brands shares a single staffed counter space, so no one brand carries high-street rent, a shop fit-out or the cost of hiring. Brands get real footfall and sales data and build a trading track record. OneNest signs the lease with the shopping centre and carries the covenant, the guarantee and the exit risk; each brand signs a short, renewable licence with OneNest instead. Brands scale through three tiers on those same terms: a shared counter in one centre, then a larger footprint and prime positioning, then a multi-centre presence under a single agreement. Every brand also gets a storefront on the OneNest marketplace, an online shop covering the whole cohort, plus a live dashboard combining counter sales and marketplace orders in one feed. Digital screens built into the counter run 15-second founder story films and QR codes linking straight to each brand's marketplace listing, so shoppers can buy in person or scan and buy later. Every hub is human-staffed and curated. The first hub launches in Newcastle in 2027.

Contact: partnership@onenest.uk
